pain_points.statement: Invoicing is three weeks delayed due to data mismatches between dispatch and CRM/accounting, freezing cash flow in unbilled receivables.
pain_points.source_excerpt: finance is 3 weeks behind on invoicing because the data never lines up.

pain_points.statement: There is a disagreement on the authorized budget range for the Phase 1 engagement between the CFO and VP of Operations.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Rita, the budget I approved is $300,000. That's the cap... Rita, that's not what we discussed. We discussed a six-month Phase 1 in the $250 to $400 range
pain_points.contradiction_note: CFO Rita Donovan strictly insists the budget cap is $300,000, whereas VP of Operations Sarah Chen believed the approved range was $250,000 to $400,000.

desired_state.statement: Structure the consulting project as a fixed-fee engagement with clear milestone-based payments.
desired_state.source_excerpt: I'll give you a fixed-fee proposal with milestone payments tied to specific outcomes

desired_state.statement: Restore invoicing timelines back to industry-standard Days Sales Outstanding (DSO).
desired_state.source_excerpt: return to industry-standard DSO on the invoicing side.

success_criteria.statement: Reduce dispatch overhead to avoid hiring four new dispatchers, saving approximately $320,000 annually.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: a 30% reduction in dispatch time means we don't need to hire four additional dispatchers next year, which is about $320k in fully-loaded comp.

success_criteria.statement: Free up approximately $1.4 million in working capital by achieving a 5-day DSO.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: return to five-day DSO from where we are now frees up about $1.4M in working capital that's currently stuck in unbilled receivables.

risks_unknowns.statement: The CFO is highly cautious and skeptical of external consultants due to a negative vendor experience in 2023.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Skeptical of consulting engagements; got burned by a previous vendor in 2023.

pain_points.statement: Stakeholders disagree on whether the core issue is an operational workflow problem or a legacy technology platform failure.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Sarah thinks this is a workflow problem. I think this is a platform problem.
pain_points.contradiction_note: CTO Marcus Patel advocates for replacing the 7-year-old custom Rails tool (Routemaster) with a $600k SaaS platform, while VP Sarah Chen advocates for incremental workflow improvements on the existing stack.

pain_points.statement: The custom dispatch tool Routemaster suffers from heavy technical debt, making code fragile and feature delivery slow.
pain_points.source_excerpt: We can't ship features anymore because the codebase is too fragile. Every change takes three times as long as it should.

desired_state.statement: Build workflow automation in a modular layer above Routemaster so the majority of logic remains portable during future platform replacements.
desired_state.source_excerpt: workflow logic in a layer on top of Routemaster, talking to Salesforce and the driver app through clean integration points... I'd estimate 60-70% of the Phase 1 work survives a platform change.

success_criteria.statement: Establish clean, maintainable integration points between Routemaster, Salesforce, and the driver app.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: talking to Salesforce and the driver app through clean integration points

risks_unknowns.statement: Two previous internal projects attempting to fix the exact same workflow and technical issues failed.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: We've tried internal projects to fix this exact thing twice and they both failed.

pain_points.statement: Dispatchers spend excessive time manually cross-entering data between the custom dispatch tool and Salesforce.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Our dispatcher workflow is killing us. Too much manual entry between our custom dispatch tool and Salesforce

pain_points.statement: Contracted drivers express dissatisfaction with the current mobile application user experience.

desired_state.statement: Prioritize solving invoicing data reconciliation first, followed by streamlining the upstream dispatcher workflow.
desired_state.source_excerpt: focus on the invoicing reconciliation first because that's directly affecting cash flow, and then the dispatcher workflow because it's the upstream cause of the bad invoicing data.

success_criteria.statement: Achieve a 30% reduction in average dispatch processing time per load.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: 30% reduction in dispatch time per load

risks_unknowns.statement: An upcoming federal ELD compliance mandate on November 15th may impact driver app requirements and risk operations if missed.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: The ELD compliance deadline in November is real. The federal mandate update changes how we have to log driver hours and report them.

pain_points.statement: There is a contradiction between leadership regarding the target delivery timeline for the pilot implementation.
pain_points.source_excerpt: We have a Q3 pilot commitment... Q3 was your commitment, not mine. I never agreed to Q3. I think Q4 is more realistic if we're doing it right.
pain_points.contradiction_note: CFO Rita Donovan and VP Sarah Chen insist on an end-of-Q3 pilot launch, whereas CTO Marcus Patel claims Q4 is the realistic timeline and rejects the Q3 date.

desired_state.statement: Deploy a functional pilot into production by the end of Q3 to protect project funding from reallocation.
desired_state.source_excerpt: If we don't have something in production by end of September, the funding gets reallocated. That part isn't negotiable.

success_criteria.statement: Deliver Phase 1 outcomes prior to September 30th within the $300,000 budget cap.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: Pilot in production by end of Q3 (Sept 30).

risks_unknowns.statement: The company risks making short-term operational fixes that conflict with long-term technology platform strategy under tight deadline constraints.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: We should not be making a multi-year platform decision under an artificial six-month deadline.
